description: The authors describe data supporting material-recovery trials in Rosignano, Karmiel, Tain, Roussillon and Kalundborg. Listed variables include adsorption-column design, hardness and COD removal, spectroscopy signals, emerging contaminants, polyphenols, ammonia stripping, nutrient precipitation and sulphur or metal recovery. Laboratory, demonstration and modelling comparisons are explicitly mixed in the document. The Kalundborg section describes a concept study using measured concentrate properties, not a completed recovery installation. A DOCX file contains the reported data; exact observation counts, reusable table layouts and overlap with energy-recovery collections remain unverified. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
